name: nexus-local
note: Nexus's OWN loop on a local Ollama model (no API key, fully offline). Set DARKNODE_MODEL to pin a model, e.g. qwen2.5-coder.

name: nexus-claude
note: Nexus orchestrating Claude Code. Needs Claude Code installed + authed (network). This is the apples-to-apples 'Nexus on the same model as Claude Code'.

name: claude-code
note: Plain Claude Code, no Nexus. Needs `claude` installed + authed (network).

name: codex
note: OpenAI Codex CLI, no Nexus. Needs `codex` installed + authed (network). Adjust the exec flags to your codex version.
